root_idea.summary: The root develops three principal orientations: a part or arrangement based on four, remaining or dwelling, and lifting or raising.
root_idea.development: From the four-part principle come the numerals, ordinal and fractional terms, distributive forms, four-stranded objects, and fourth-day cycles. From remaining or dwelling come abode, seasonal residence, pasture, and related fertility meanings; from lifting come raising stones or loads, strength, and derived capacity expressions.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized numeral headword أَرْبَع.
The temporal-tagged occurrence is the same numeral أربعين, meaning forty, and belongs under the same public numeral form.
Displayed under the normalized feminine numeral headword أَرْبَعَة.
Displayed as the ordinal active-participial form رَابِع.
Displayed as the distributive numeral رُبَاع.
Displayed as the fractional noun رُبُع.

senses.usage_conditions: A cardinal numeral; its Quranic occurrences include inflected forms such as أَرْبَعٍ and أَرْبَعُ.
The tens numeral expressed in inflected forms such as أَرْبَعِينَ.
The cardinal numeral أَرْبَعَة, used in its Quranic inflected forms in counting expressions and periods.

senses.definition: Fourth; the one occupying the fourth position or joining three others to make four.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the construction رَابِعُهُمْ, “the fourth of them.”

senses.definition: Four at a time; four each.
senses.usage_conditions: A distributive numeral used in the Quranic construction وَرُبَاعَ.

senses.definition: A fourth part; one quarter or a quarter-share.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, the term denotes the prescribed quarter-share of an inheritance; the broader lexical branch also covers a fourth part of a possession or spoil.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take a fourth part of someone's property or spoil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I use; the reported pre-Islamic spoil-share was later reduced to a fifth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become the fourth, add oneself to three, or make a group four or forty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form I and Form IV uses describe either joining a group or causing its numerical increase.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To twist or make something of four strands or twists.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a rope, bowstring, or bridle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow a fourth-day cycle of watering; to bring camels to water on the fourth day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The day of the preceding watering may be counted as the first; the same cycle is applied to visits and related activities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have, or be seized by, a quartan fever.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The fever returns on the fourth day after an intervening two-day interval.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come fourth in a race.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be struck or injured in the regions of the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive Form I expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of rain, to water land and cause it to produce herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related passive expression describes land or camels receiving the seasonal rain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to sweat in its legs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from rain watering the earth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To restore someone from poverty, difficulty, embarrassment, or destruction to competence or well-being.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or passive participial use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the season called ربيع to commence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A seasonal Form I expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain, settle, or dwell in a place; to alight and stay where pasture is abundant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Originally associated with residence during ربيع, then extended to residence generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For camels to feed freely in pasture, eating and drinking as they please.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive use distinct from the fourth-day watering cycle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act according to one's own judgment concerning water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized idiomatic use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have or obtain abundant herbage produced by the spring season or its rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a person or place benefiting from seasonal growth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pause, proceed deliberately, restrain oneself, refrain, or deal gently and compassionately.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in idioms such as اِرْبَعْ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ and رَبَعَ عَلَيْهِ; some applications are explicitly figurative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a young camel to widen its stride and run.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-behavior use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To raise or carry a stone for a trial of strength; the stone so raised is called رَبِيعَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The action may be performed by one person or jointly by competing persons.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To raise a load onto a camel or other beast, using a lifting staff or the help of another person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The instrument مِرْبَعَة is a staff used beneath the load.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To approve of, be satisfied with, or be content with one's life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A stative Form I use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something fourfold, four-sided, square, quadrilateral, or shaped like a quadruped.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The derived adjective may describe four portions, sides, faces, angles, or legs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring forth a fourth offspring; a fourth young one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The nominal use رِبْع denotes the fourth offspring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain four nights with someone, especially with one's wife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same derived verb can be extended to other actions or statements performed four times or over four units.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Watering seed-produce on the fourth day in the established watering cycle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It follows the cycle called تثليث.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hiring or bargaining for work by the season called ربيع.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III seasonal contract expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sit cross-legged.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The posture is contrasted with kneeling and crouching.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To find or remain among spring herbage; of an animal, to feed on it and become fat and lively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to camels and horses, and by extension to their place of pasture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For palm trees to have their fruit cut off.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is associated with the season called ربيع in its regional usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a she-camel to carry or develop a tall hump.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized derived-form use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie with one another in lifting a stone for a trial of strength.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a camel to beat the ground with all its legs and go quickly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VIII animal-motion use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of middling stature, neither tall nor short.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to people and, in related usage, to a spear or compactly built horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look for, expect, or await being made commander or lord over a people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form VIII idiom.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have the power, ability, strength, or endurance to do or bear something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to tasks, warfare, travel, envy, and independent execution of work.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For sand to become heaped up, or for dust to rise or rise high.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form X intransitive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of alighting, dwelling, or settled residence; a home or house.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Originally a place of residence in the spring season, later used for a dwelling generally; its plural forms include رِبَاع and رُبُوع.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The people of a dwelling or settlement; a company, tribe, or large number of people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the dwelling itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bier, or a bier bearing a corpse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An assumed figurative extension from a place where people alight or rest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The extremity of a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An assumed figurative extension associated with a place where travelers stop.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fourth part or quarter; in technical usage, a quarter-share or quarter measure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The contracted form رُبْعٌ is reported alongside رُبُعٌ; specialized measures vary by regional convention.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The four regions or sections of the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural anatomical expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The interval or watering schedule in which camels return to water on the fourth day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact counting convention is reported with variant descriptions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A young camel born in the season called ربيع.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is connected with the young animal's widening stride and running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small star in the midst of the stars called العَوَائِذ in the head of Draco.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized astronomical designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small round leather-covered basket or a four-sided vessel used for perfumes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form is explained by its four compartments, layers, or legs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A chest or container in which Quran volumes are kept.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Marked as a post-classical usage associated with Baghdad.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person's former or proper state, condition, affair, course, or manner of conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may also mean remaining occupied with one's established business or remaining in one's dwelling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Leadership, headship, or responsibility for a people; a chief who traditionally took the fourth share of spoil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The leadership sense is metaphorically connected with the chief's أخذ المرباع.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel's quick or forceful pace or running.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Authorities differ over whether the pace is especially vehement or a less vehement kind of running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Relating to the season ربيع, its rain, herbage, or early breeding; born in that season or at the beginning of a period.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can describe early offspring, seasonal provision, an expedition, or the beginning or prime of something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having shed the tooth called رَبَاعِيَة; at the corresponding age of a sheep, bovine, solid-hoofed animal, or camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The age differs by animal; the Form IV verb describes the shedding itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vehement and youthful war.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An assumed figurative use connected with youth and vigor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that yields four measures of milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-noun use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The season called spring or ربيع; its rain; or the green herbage produced by that rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Arab usage applies ربيع variously to seasons, months, autumnal or winter rains, spring herbage, and the two months named ربيع الأول and ربيع الآخر.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rivulet, streamlet, or small river, especially one watering cultivated land or palms.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from flowing seasonal water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A share or portion of water used for irrigating land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The duration-based specification of a quarter-day or quarter-night is reported as unsupported by some authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sharpest kind of thrusting or piercing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An assumed figurative expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stone raised for a trial of strength.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is restricted in the cited evidence to a stone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An iron helmet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A meadow or garden.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Synonymous with رَوْضَة in the cited evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A leathern water-bag.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized container noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A boy four spans in height; by extension, a camel of the corresponding measure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A measurement adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Composed of four letters.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A grammatical or descriptive technical use, applied to a word whose radicals or radicals and augmentations total four.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tooth between the central incisor and the canine; the four corresponding teeth in humans or other animals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is رَبَاعِيَات.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who frequently buys or sells houses or dwellings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Derived from رِبَاع in the sense of houses or places of abode.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The quickest among a group to conceive or become pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized comparative-like epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Quadrupeds, literally beings possessing four.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural nominal expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In an idiom, tears flowing from the four sides of the eyes, or vehement weeping.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An illustrative figurative expression, not a restriction on the ordinary numeral.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wednesday, the fourth day of the week.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word has several reported vocalizations and gender analyses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fortieth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The ordinal use is distinct from the cardinal number forty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who fasts alone on Wednesday.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized derivative from the weekday name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel watered on the fourth-day cycle or brought to water at any time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The latter application is an additional specialized use of the same adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rain that comes in the season ربيع, confines people to their dwellings, or causes spring herbage to grow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied also to land that produces herbage in that season and to a she-camel bearing young then.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that gives birth in the season ربيع, usually gives birth then, or becomes pregnant early.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related adjective may also describe a camel whose womb is closed and does not admit seminal fluid.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sail of a fully laden ship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Contrasted with the sail of an empty ship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land containing jerboas.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective is formed like other place nouns denoting the presence of an animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rope, bowstring, or bridle twisted from four strands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same form can describe a spear of four cubits or something neither long nor short.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A receptacle for perfume and similar goods.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized container sense distinct from the water-bag and helmet senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having square or quadrilateral features; figuratively, having very hairy eyebrows or a square forehead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The square-forehead expression is further used as a designation for a slave in the cited idiom.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person described by a square forehead; in the cited figurative expression, a slave.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized assumed-tropical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The jerboa, a small long-eared and long-tailed animal whose hind legs exceed its forelegs in length.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is also explained by the four entrances of its burrow; the plural is يَرَابِيع.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The portions of flesh and sinew beside the backbone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the jerboa; some authorities report a variant vocalization and no singular.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A neighbor variable in his actions and expedients, like a jerboa.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic comparison.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The asker-returning idiom is covered under the broader refrain/return idiom.
Distinct sexual idiom is represented under the related classical idiom entry.
The rapid return and abundance of water are grouped as the water-related branch.
Distinct sexual idiom: an abominable request for anal intercourse.

cautions: The Quranic occurrence count is 22 across six QAC form groups; the public numeral form أَرْبَع combines the nominal and temporal-tagged QAC groups because the lexical item is the same numeral.
Lane reports variant conventions for the fourth-day watering cycle and for the seasons and months called ربيع.
The Quranic use of رُبُع is securely a quarter-share; Lane's related contracted form رُبْع is retained separately in broader Classical coverage where its technical and regional uses are explicit.
Lane's bracketed historical Quran references were not converted into modern verse locations unless the corresponding QAC location was independently supplied.
